headline: Proposed zoning amendments on accessory dwelling units and removing ground story elevation requirements.
summary: Two Mayor's requests are up for recommendation. One aligns zoning with state law on protected accessory dwelling units; the other removes ground story elevation requirements from several zoning sections.
items: Mayor's request to amend the Somerville Zoning Ordinance to align with state law on protected accessory dwelling units (ID 26-1336), referred for recommendation
Mayor's request to amend the Somerville Zoning Ordinances to remove ground story elevation requirements (ID 26-1259), referred for recommendation
